detail: The Associated Press reported that a localized ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia took effect at 3 a.m. Tuesday ahead of a humanitarian mission to the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky. Russian and Ukrainian negotiators and militaries separately confirmed that the pause had begun.

The next test is whether the pause lasts through the operation and whether aid, demining, and evacuations actually move. Previous ceasefires have been undermined by mistrust, so implementation is more important than the announcement.

The next race is the Azerbaijan Grand Prix on the published calendar. The open question is whether Antonelli’s Monza pace travels to a very different circuit.
